_comment: The MIDI implementation chart — one source of truth rendered by src/components/Chart.astro and VERIFIED by tools/chart_check.py against the Play-mode byte logs (docs/evidence/step26/bytelogs, recorded on the iPad and the Galaxy Tab at each shell's merge point; src 1 finger, 2 session config, 3 strip, 4 stylus). `expect` on output rows: present = must appear in that session's log, absent = must never appear, conditional = appears only when the gesture happens (allowed either way). Input sections are verified by the headless normalizer suite (tests/normalizer_tests.cpp).

sections.title: Input · MPE mode
sections.intro: ROLI Piano / Seaboard, Expressive E Osmose, the tablets' own Play surface (loopback) and any DAW replaying them. Entered on an MPE Configuration Message, or when note-ons spread across channels 2+ with per-channel bend/pressure; forced with sumi_set_input_mode.

rows.meaning: VoiceBegin — strike: drop radius ∝ √velocity at the layout's position(s)
rows.notes: One active note per member channel; a same-channel overlap steals the voice (the stylus legato relies on this).

rows.meaning: VoiceEnd — lift: the drop sets, feeding stops
rows.notes: Nothing is stamped. A Note Off naming a note the channel no longer sounds is ignored.

rows.meaning: VoiceGlide — bend_mode 0: drags the drop along the pitch axis (a local tine); bend_mode 1: feeds the ripple, drop holds
rows.notes: Range ±48 st by default (RPN 0 honoured). One consumer owns the note bend; the switch is clean both ways.

rows.meaning: VoicePress — press_mode 0: sustained ink feed (boundary growth, unbounded); press_mode 1: the Lamb–Oseen swirl
rows.notes: Smoothed (~30 ms), one value per voice per frame. The Osmose behaviour.

rows.meaning: VoiceSwirl — the Lamb–Oseen swirl at the voice's centre, unconditionally
rows.notes: No reference hardware sends it; the Play surface's Y-down does. Sign from band parity.

rows.meaning: VoiceSlide — slide_mode 0: per-drop hue/ink density; slide_mode 1: Hamiltonian pinch at the drop
rows.notes: Reserved: not routable through the CC map on member channels.

rows.meaning: Global shear tine (range ±2 st)
rows.notes: In both bend modes.

rows.meaning: GlobalCtl vortex strength (exponential profile) — the mod wheel
rows.notes: Default CC map; remappable.

rows.meaning: Ignored by the canvas in MPE mode (it is a pedal for the synth downstream)
rows.notes: DECISIONS_3 #67: the paper dip is a settings action here.

rows.meaning: MPE Configuration Message — zone membership
rows.notes: Single zone; dual-zone configs are logged and ignored. Default with no MCM: master 1, members 2–16.

rows.meaning: Per-channel bend range
rows.notes: Default 48 on members, 2 on the master.

rows.meaning: GlobalCtl — the CC map: vortex strength / centre X / Y, viscosity, roughness, palette morph, ink flow, ripple amp / freq
rows.notes: Airwave defaults as measured (L/R pairs): 26 Raise L → vortex strength, 24 Glide L → centre X, 22 Slide L → centre Y, 29 Tilt R → viscosity, 30 Flex L → roughness, 31 Flex R → palette, 27 Raise R → ripple amount, 28 Tilt L → ripple wavelength; 20/21 Grasp, 23, 25 unmapped. Desktop also routes CC 102/103 to the ripple.

rows.meaning: Ignored
rows.notes: Out of scope by design; the ingest path does not preclude UMP later.

sections.title: Input · Wind mode
sections.intro: Roland Aerophone Brisa, Odisei Travel Sax, any breath controller: notes on one channel plus a dense CC 2 stream.

rows.meaning: The one voice: a wandering ink brush. First note = VoiceBegin; a legato note change = VoiceMigrate (the brush travels, drawing a wake)
rows.notes: Never a disconnected new drop while a note is held.

rows.meaning: VoiceEnd when the last held note releases
Breath → the brush's WIDTH (relaxes toward 0.006 + 0.05·breath canvas heights)
rows.notes: Bounded on purpose: a 20 s line stays a line, not a blob.

rows.meaning: Global shear tine (±2 st)

sections.title: Input · Classic mode
sections.intro: Any single-channel keyboard; the fallback when neither MPE nor wind is detected.

rows.meaning: Each note is its own voice — strike only (drop radius ∝ √velocity)
Global shear tine (±2 st)
Vortex strength (mod wheel)
PaperDip on the rising edge — a fresh sheet
rows.notes: Classic mode ONLY (DECISIONS_3 #67).

sections.title: Output · Session configuration (src 2)
sections.intro: Sent on both pipes — into the loopback on Play-mode entry, out on every sink at session open, on a sink appearing mid-session and on “Re-sync DAW”. Never rate-limited.

rows.meaning: RPN MSB = 0 (MCM, then RPN 0)
rows.notes: Order asserted: 101=0, 100=6, 6=15 on the master, then 101=0, 100=0, 6=48 on every member.

rows.meaning: RPN LSB = 6 → the MPE Configuration Message
MCM: lower zone, 15 member channels
RPN MSB = 0
RPN LSB = 0 → bend range
Bend range = 48 semitones, on all 15 members
rows.notes: The strip sends NO RPN 0 on the master: the master stays at the MPE default ±2.

sections.title: Output · Finger voices (src 1)
sections.intro: One joystick per touch on the lattice. Touch-down: centre bend, then Note On. Lift: pressure 0 (and 0xA0 = 0 if the swirl half is engaged), then Note Off.

rows.meaning: Centre (8192) before every Note On; then X → semitones along the cell's pitch axis: pb = 8192 + round(st/48·8192), one semitone = ±171 counts
rows.notes: Soft knee inside the cell circle, identity beyond it — a one-cell drag is exactly one semitone.

rows.meaning: Cell note, velocity 96 (touch-size modulation behind a setting)
rows.notes: Allocator: least-recently-released round-robin over 15 channels; externally held channels masked; saturation = silent drop + HUD blink, never steal.

rows.meaning: Y up → ink feed, 0…127 on the knee; 0 before every Note Off
rows.notes: Two-byte message on the wire.

rows.meaning: Y down → the Lamb–Oseen swirl, keyed by the voice's note
rows.notes: Many MPE synths ignore 0xA0 — primarily a visualizer dimension that happens to be recordable.

rows.meaning: Release velocity 64 (unmeasured)
Fingers emit no CC 74, ever — timbre belongs to the stylus
rows.notes: Asserted in every log: 0 finger CC 74.

sections.title: Output · Stylus voices (src 4)
sections.intro: Apple Pencil / S-Pen: absolute-position play with per-cell legato. Crossing into a new cell (±0.65 st past the current note) emits bend → Note On (new) → Note Off (old) on the SAME channel.

rows.meaning: Centre before the first strike; the in-cell offset live at ×1 (vibrato), ×1→×3 while the Pencil Pro barrel rolls (τ = 0.4 s decay); the cell offset before each legato retrigger
rows.notes: Never accumulates past half a cell: the retrigger re-anchors it.

rows.meaning: Velocity from tip force: Pencil 96 + (max(force,1) − 1)·15.5; S-Pen 96 + 31·t
rows.notes: A legato Note On is followed, not preceded, by the old note's Off.

rows.meaning: The old note after a retrigger; the last note after pressure 0 on lift
True tip force, change-only; 0 before the final Note Off
Y about the strike → 64 ± 63 (up = brighter), change-only
rows.notes: Under slide_mode = 1 it goes OUTBOUND ONLY: the shell pinches through sumi_add_pinch directly, and a looped CC 74 would pinch twice.

rows.meaning: The stylus has no swirl axis

sections.title: Output · Control strip and pen pedal (src 3)
sections.intro: The floating palette. Every message on the MASTER channel — member channels are never touched. Wheels are policed as continuous dimensions on the outbound pipe; buttons are never dropped.

rows.meaning: Pitch spring wheel, ±2 st; release ramps ~50 ms to a guaranteed exact-centre final message
rows.notes: Unaffected by bend_mode.

rows.meaning: Mod latch wheel — relative deltas, no absolute entry point
rows.notes: Loopback routes it to the vortex.

rows.meaning: Assignable A (default; loopback: viscosity)
rows.notes: Reassignable by long-press; protocol CCs (1, 6, 38, 64, 98–101, 120–127) refused.

rows.meaning: Assignable B (default; loopback: roughness)
rows.notes: Natural homes for the ripple's CC 102/103.

rows.meaning: Sustain — the strip's pad, the Pencil Pro squeeze, the S-Pen barrel button: one engine. Momentary by default (127 / 0), toggle behind a setting
rows.notes: Never dropped; asserted balanced with the last value 0. Not a paper dip in Play mode.

rows.meaning: Panic: every voice released (pressure 0 → Note Off), then CC 64 = 0 and CC 123 = 0 on the master and all members
rows.notes: Exempt from limiting; on the loopback and every transport.

not_captured.title: What a DAW recording does not capture
items: The stylus WAKE (the dipolar wake behind every pen stroke) is physical, never MIDI: a DAW replay of a stylus performance reproduces notes, bends, CC 74 and pressure exactly — and no wakes, because a DAW has no stylus in the water.
Marble-mode gestures (tap, drag, twist, pinch) generate zero MIDI.
CC 74 under slide_mode = 1 reaches the DAW but not the loopback; a replay still pinches, via the normalizer's CC 74 route with the pitch-axis fold — a different fold axis than the live pen's azimuth.

Outbound pipes are rate-limited (100 Hz per voice per dimension; ~300 msg/s total on BLE) while the loopback is full-rate: a recording is a faithful but decimated view of the continuous dimensions. Note On/Off, the centre bend, pressure-0-before-Note-Off and CC 64 are never dropped.
Our own bytes echoed back by a transport (a DAW thru, a looping network session) are consumed inside 300 ms and never re-enter — the recording is what left the device.
